description: This file defines the MidiInputPortSelector class, which manages a user interface component for selecting a MIDI input port and handles opening/closing the associated MIDI device and port.

classes.name: MidiInputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that extends MidiPortSelector to manage MIDI input port selection, opening the device and port, providing a MidiReceiver, and cleanup operations.

methods.name: MidiInputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the selector with MIDI manager, activity, and UI spinner ID.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a port is selected: opens the device and port asynchronously.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver associated with the input port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI input port and device, releasing resources.
